description: Repères de nivellement du canevas géodésique de Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geodesie.ign.fr. This layer of points is one of the elements of the geodetic canvas of Rennes Métropole. For information, a canvas is a set of known geodetic points in position and serving as a framework for the realization of a topographic survey. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Benchmarks for the levelling of the Rennes Métropole geodetic canvas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include référentiels : altitude, données ouvertes, altitude, geobretagne. The listing shows 2015-04-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
